effects: The signer sends exactly `assets` USDT to the vault (enter: safeTransferFrom(asset, msg.sender, address(this), assets)).
onBehalf receives newly minted vault shares. The amount is previewDeposit(assets), set by the vault's stored share price after fees accrue. There is no minimum.
formats.shown: Deposit 10 USDT for <onBehalf>. Fields: the USDT amount, a fixed 'Share ticker' fcUSDT, and the share recipient.

findings.title: deposit: the hard-coded 'Share ticker' fcUSDT differs from the vault's on-chain symbol fUSDTe.
findings.evidence: descriptor.json deposit field {label 'Share ticker', value $.metadata.constants.vaultTicker = 'fcUSDT'}; case 0 mined share transfer to the signer has symbol 'fUSDTe'; VaultV2.sol symbol is set by setSymbol and can change.
findings.fix: Drop the constant ticker field, or set vaultTicker to the on-chain symbol. Better: show the shares through a field that resolves the token from @.to.

findings.title: deposit: the number of shares received is not shown and has no minimum.
findings.evidence: VaultV2.sol deposit: shares = previewDeposit(assets), computed from storage (accrueInterestView). Case 0: the signer received 9.993643 fUSDTe and the screen shows no share amount.
findings.fix: No calldata value exists. Optionally relabel the recipient as 'Send shares (at vault price) to'.

cases.notes: The 10 USDT out is shown right. The shares in go to the signer as shown, but the amount is missing and the ticker differs from the on-chain symbol fUSDTe.

formats.key: withdraw(uint256 assets, address receiver, address onBehalf)
effects: The signer's vault shares (from onBehalf) are burned. The amount is previewWithdraw(assets), rounded up from the stored price, with no maximum.
Exactly `assets` USDT goes from the vault to receiver.
If msg.sender is not onBehalf, onBehalf's share allowance to the caller drops by the burned shares.
formats.shown: Withdraw 71000 USDT to <receiver>. Fields: exact USDT amount, recipient, and owner of the burned shares.

findings.title: withdraw: the number of shares burned is not shown and has no maximum in calldata.
findings.evidence: VaultV2.sol withdraw: shares = previewWithdraw(assets); exit: deleteShares(onBehalf, shares). Case 2: 70958.571 fUSDTe burned from the signer, not on screen.
findings.fix: No calldata value exists. Optionally say 'Burns vault shares from' on the Owner label.

cases.notes: 71000 USDT in is shown right. The share burn is only implied by 'Owner'; the reader understood the position shrinks but not by how many shares.

formats.key: redeem(uint256 shares, address receiver, address onBehalf)
effects: Exactly `shares` vault shares are burned from onBehalf. The allowance is spent when the caller is not onBehalf.
USDT goes from the vault to receiver. The amount is previewRedeem(shares), set by the stored price, with no minimum.
formats.shown: Redeem 115147.616983 fcUSDT to <receiver>. Fields: shares, recipient, owner. The asset paid out is never named.

findings.title: redeem: the screen never names USDT as the asset the receiver gets.
findings.evidence: VaultV2.sol exit: SafeERC20Lib.safeTransfer(asset, receiver, assets). The descriptor redeem fields show only shares, receiver and owner, though the mint format already shows constant underlyingTicker. Case 3: the signer received 115155.747961 USDT; the reader was 'unsure whether the underlying is really USDT'.
findings.fix: Add a field 'Receive asset' with value $.metadata.constants.underlyingTicker. Relabel 'To' as 'Send USDT to'.

findings.title: redeem: the USDT amount received is not shown and has no minimum.
findings.evidence: VaultV2.sol redeem: assets = previewRedeem(shares), from storage. Case 3: 115155.747961 USDT in, not on screen.

cases.notes: The share burn is shown right. The reader expected 'probably USDT' in, with no amount; the asset is not named on screen.

effects: The signer pays USDT to the vault. The amount is previewMint(shares), rounded up from the stored price, with no maximum except the signer's approval.
Exactly `shares` vault shares are minted to onBehalf.
formats.shown: Mint 1 fcUSDT for <onBehalf>. Fields: deposit asset USDT (no amount), shares minted, and their recipient.

findings.title: mint: the intent says 'Mint' and the sentence never says the signer pays USDT.
findings.evidence: descriptor.json mint intent 'Mint', interpolatedIntent 'Mint {#.shares} for {#.onBehalf}'. VaultV2.sol enter: safeTransferFrom(asset, msg.sender, ...). Case 1: the signer paid 1 USDT. Only the separate 'Deposit asset: USDT' field hints at a payment.
findings.fix: Use intent 'Deposit USDT for shares' and interpolatedIntent 'Pay USDT to mint {#.shares} for {#.onBehalf}'.

findings.title: mint: the USDT amount paid is not shown and has no maximum in calldata.
findings.evidence: VaultV2.sol mint: assets = previewMint(shares), from storage. Case 1: 1 USDT left the signer, and the screen shows no USDT amount.
findings.fix: No calldata value exists. Label could say 'Pay USDT (amount at vault price)'.

cases.notes: The reader knew USDT leaves but not how much. The shares went to 0xdEaD, which the screen shows plainly and the reader understood.
